cd /app && python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
ds = load_dataset('ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample','metadata',split='train')
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct')
sci = {'physics','chemistry','biology'}
rows=[r for r in ds if r['domain'] in sci]
print('n rows',len(rows))
def c(field):
    return sum(len(tok(r[field], add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids']) for r in rows)
reasoning=c('deepseek_reasoning'); solution=c('deepseek_solution')
print('reasoning',reasoning)
print('solution',solution)
print('sum',reasoning+solution)
" 2>&1 | grep -v Warning
